name: long_lb_fa4pw_v4
long_context_execution: all arms: memory-linear GLOBAL causal / LOCAL sliding prefill via the 64-row kernel, elided O(n^2) prefill mask mapping, token-chunked MoE (V27_PREFILL_DENSE64=1); canvas calls follow each arm | decoding substrate piecewise_v1 (torch 2.12.1 grouped_mm MoE; decoder compiled reduce-overhead, split at GLOBAL attention which runs eager; LOCAL attention graphed unless the arm routes LOCAL layers; official-style compiled sampler); untimed per-arm warm-up before timed requests
selection_rule: v27 LongBench-v2 32K/64K panel re-run on the strong substrate with the official SOTA dense kernel, same items and seeds as v27_long_lb. Every sparse arm executes through FlashAttention-4's block-sparse interface. Dense: D_native (HF SDPA, the official model path), D_fa4 (FA4 plain dense path), D_fa4_allkept (FA4 block-sparse API, every tile kept; bitwise equal to D_fa4, fastest official dense). Fan plain M1/M2c/M3 (A8, pipelined exact selector) always present; variants layered on top: B/A64, M1 A64 (pipelined and dense-prefix), M2c A64, M3 R3/R6 A64, M3 R6 partial sharing (pairs), M3 R6 last GLOBAL layer dense, and the vLLM-era G75 F/S15/S30 observe-once-then-hold port. Cross-layer full sharing (one) dropped: it collapsed quality on v27_long_lb. Junyu fresh T omitted: its bridge binaries are built for torch 2.6. Frozen before any generation on this substrate. v2 (supersedes v1 before any generation): every block runs on one H100 (dllm) because the second GPU (mpk) is in active interactive use by another group member; one host also removes cross-host variance. v3 (supersedes v2 before any accepted generation; v2 was stopped after 47 executions for these fixes): LOCAL sliding-window cache compacted after every encoder call (HF kept it as a slice of the full concatenation: the whole prompt LOCAL K/V retained and prompt-dependent strides that recompiled the decoder in timed requests), FA4 block-list cache sized for 30 routed layers (G75 S15/S30 thrashed a 16-entry cache), G75 step-0 bootstrap on the cached all-kept FA4 path, and a two-prompt runner warm-up. v4: the same 17 arms, items and seeds re-run on substrate piecewise_v2 (shared prefill and GLOBAL canvas append on official FA4) so the final end-to-end numbers come from the strongest substrate; v3 vs v4 isolates the substrate change.
